description: This file declares utility functions related to tensor options and type string conversions within the torch::utils namespace. Functions include options_to_string, type_to_string, options_from_string, and backend_to_string, as well as a function to retrieve all declared tensor types.

methods.name: options_to_string
methods.description: Converts tensor options to a string representation.

methods.name: type_to_string
methods.description: Converts deprecated type properties to a string representation.

methods.name: options_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to produce tensor options.

methods.name: all_declared_types
methods.description: Returns a vector of all declared tensor backend and scalar type pairs, including those not compiled.

methods.name: backend_to_string
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given backend, e.g., 'torch.cuda'.
